author: gobernment
body:
Hey,

I have a few questions for you, the community, regarding Sky Wars. Staff are free to participate as well in this survey, and at the end I have some statements to make. Please answer these truthfully as we will take this into consideration.

What kind of meta do you want Sky Wars to have?
A. Spacious islands, lesser worth loot (Mineplex)
B. Close islands (five blocks from eachother), more worth loot (Hypixel)
C. A little bit of both
What should most of the middles be like?
A. Lots of loot, large and spacious
B. Lots of loot, small and cramping
C. Little loot, used as control point of map
D. Both two answers mixed
Do you like the idea of enderpearls in Sky Wars?
A. Yes
B. No
How should the game handle time limits?
A. Spawn dragons each per minute
B. World border making islands crumble
C. Players taking damage with a world border
D. Sudden death (all teleported to middle)
E. None of the above
Should we have kits, or loadouts?
A. Kits (Standardized, easier for mapmakers)
B. Loadouts (More customized)
C. No supplies
Should Sky Wars be its own server, or an arcade game?
A. Give it its own server
B. Keep it on arcade

Now, I also ask of you to make maps for Sky Wars once this post has been answered.
I would also like to confirm this gamemode under development (how it's used is a different story).
A module is being made by the devs to randomize chest loot with a YML, much like SG was.

Please post your answers below.
